name: St Alexander of Alexandria
label: saint
bio: The bishop who first stood against Arius and led the Church at the First Council of Nicaea, with his deacon Athanasius.

works.t: Epistles on the Arian Heresy and the Deposition of Arius

name: St Athanasius the Great
label: saint
bio: Bishop of Alexandria, exiled five times for defending the faith of Nicaea. On the Incarnation is one of the best books ever written on why God became man.

works.t: On the Incarnation of the Word
Vita S. Antoni (Life of St. Anthony)

name: St Basil the Great
label: saint
bio: Archbishop of Caesarea, one of the Three Holy Hierarchs. He wrote On the Holy Spirit and gave the Church the Liturgy that bears his name.

name: St Clement of Rome
label: saint
bio: An early bishop of Rome. His letter to the Corinthians calls a divided church back to peace and order.

name: St Cyprian of Carthage
label: saint
bio: Bishop of Carthage and martyr. He wrote on the unity of the Church, the Lord's Prayer and those who fell away in persecution.

works.t: The Life and Passion of Cyprian

name: St Cyril of Jerusalem
label: saint
bio: Archbishop of Jerusalem. His Catechetical Lectures explain the Creed and the Holy Mysteries to the newly baptised.

name: St Dionysius of Alexandria
label: saint
bio: Bishop of Alexandria in a time of plague and persecution. His letters survive in pieces.

name: St Dionysius of Rome
label: saint
bio: Bishop of Rome who wrote against those who blurred the Persons of the Trinity.

name: St Ephrem the Syrian
label: saint
bio: Deacon of Nisibis and Edessa, the 'Harp of the Spirit'. His hymns teach the faith in poetry. His Lenten prayer is said in every Orthodox church.

works.t: On the Nativity of Christ in the Flesh
For the Feast of the Epiphany

name: St Gregory of Nyssa
label: saint
bio: Brother of St Basil and a great teacher on the Trinity, the soul and the endless growth of the soul toward God.

works.t: On the Holy Spirit (Against the Followers of Macedonius)
On the Holy Trinity, and of the Godhead of the Holy Spirit (To Eustathius)
On the Soul and the Resurrection
On the Baptism of Christ (Sermon for the Day of Lights)

name: St Gregory the Theologian
label: saint
bio: Archbishop of Constantinople, one of the Three Holy Hierarchs. His Theological Orations are the classic teaching on the Holy Trinity.

name: St Gregory the Wonderworker
label: saint
bio: A student of Origen who became bishop of Neocaesarea. Known for his miracles and his short statement of faith in the Trinity.

works.t: A Metaphrase of the Book of Ecclesiastes
The Oration and Panegyric Addressed to Origen
On the Subject of the Soul

name: St Hippolytus of Rome
label: saint
bio: A priest of Rome and martyr. He wrote against heresies and on Daniel and the end times.

works.t: Against Plato, On the Cause of the Universe

name: St Ignatius of Antioch
label: saint
bio: Bishop of Antioch after the Apostles. On his way to martyrdom in Rome he wrote seven letters on unity, the bishop and the Eucharist.

name: St Irenaeus of Lyons
label: saint
bio: A disciple of St Polycarp and bishop of Lyons. Against Heresies answers the Gnostics with the faith handed down from the Apostles.

works.t: Fragments from the Lost Writings of Irenaeus

name: St John Cassian
label: saint
bio: A monk who learned from the Desert Fathers of Egypt and brought their teaching to the West in his Institutes and Conferences.

works.t: On the Incarnation of the Lord (Against Nestorius)

name: St John Chrysostom
label: saint
bio: Archbishop of Constantinople and the Church's greatest preacher, one of the Three Holy Hierarchs. His homilies go verse by verse through much of the New Testament. The Divine Liturgy most often served bears his name.

works.t: Homilies on the Gospel of St. Matthew
Homilies on the Gospel of John
Homilies on the Epistle to the Hebrews
No One Can Harm the Man Who Does Not Injure Himself
Two Letters to Theodore After His Fall
Three Homilies on the Power of Satan
Homily on the Passage "Father, if it be possible ..."
Homily on the Paralytic Lowered Through the Roof
Homily on the Passage "If your enemy hunger, feed him."
Homily Against Publishing the Errors of the Brethren
Second Homily on Eutropius (After His Captivity)
Letter to Some Priests of Antioch

name: St John of Damascus
label: saint
bio: A monk of St Sabbas and great defender of the holy icons. His Exposition of the Orthodox Faith sums up the teaching of the Fathers before him.

name: St Justin Martyr
label: saint
bio: A philosopher who found Christ and defended the faith before the emperors. His First Apology gives the oldest description of the Sunday Liturgy.

works.t: On the Sole Government of God
Fragments of the Lost Work on the Resurrection
Martyrdom of Justin, Chariton, and other Roman Martyrs

name: St Methodius of Olympus
label: saint
bio: Bishop and martyr. His Banquet of the Ten Virgins praises chastity; he also wrote against Origen's views on the resurrection.

works.t: The Banquet of the Ten Virgins
From the Discourse on the Resurrection
Three Fragments from the Homily on the Cross and Passion of Christ

name: St Pamphilus of Caesarea
label: saint
bio: A priest, scholar and martyr who built the great library of Caesarea.

works.t: Exposition on the Acts of the Apostles

name: St Papias of Hierapolis
label: saint
bio: A hearer of the Apostle John. Only fragments of his writings survive, mostly about the Gospels.

name: St Peter of Alexandria
label: saint
bio: Bishop of Alexandria and the 'seal of the martyrs'. His canons on those who lapsed in persecution are part of Orthodox church law.

name: St Polycarp of Smyrna
label: saint
bio: A disciple of St John the Apostle and bishop of Smyrna, burned for Christ at 86. His letter and the account of his martyrdom are among the oldest Christian writings.

name: St Theophilus of Antioch
label: saint
bio: Bishop of Antioch. His books to Autolycus are the first to use the word 'Trinity'.

name: St Victorinus of Pettau
label: saint
bio: Bishop and martyr who wrote the oldest Latin commentary on the Book of Revelation.

works.t: On the Creation of the World
Commentary on the Apocalypse of the Blessed John

name: St Ambrose of Milan
label: western
bio: Bishop of Milan, who baptised Augustine and stood up to an emperor. A great preacher and hymn writer.

works.t: On the Duties of the Clergy

name: Blessed Augustine of Hippo
label: blessed
bio: Bishop of Hippo in North Africa. His Confessions are loved by all Christians. The Orthodox honour him while setting aside parts of his teaching, such as his view of the Holy Spirit's procession and of grace.

works.t: On the Catechising of the Uninstructed
Concerning Faith of Things Not Seen
On the Creed: A Sermon to Catechumens
On Care to be Had For the Dead
On the Morals of the Catholic Church
On the Morals of the Manichaeans
On Two Souls, Against the Manichaeans
Acts or Disputation Against Fortunatus the Manichaean
Against the Epistle of Manichaeus Called Fundamental
Concerning the Nature of Good, Against the Manichaeans
Answer to Letters of Petilian, Bishop of Cirta
Merits and Remission of Sin, and Infant Baptism
On the Spirit and the Letter
On the Grace of Christ, and on Original Sin
On the Soul and its Origin
Against Two Letters of the Pelagians
The Predestination of the Saints/Gift of Perseverance
Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount
Sermons on Selected Lessons of the New Testament
Tractates on the Gospel of John
Homilies on the First Epistle of John
The Enarrations, or Expositions, on the Psalms

name: St Gregory the Dialogist
label: western
bio: Bishop of Rome, a monk and pastor. The Orthodox call him the Dialogist after his Dialogues, and serve the Liturgy of the Presanctified Gifts in his name.

name: St Hilary of Poitiers
label: western
bio: Bishop in Gaul, called the 'Athanasius of the West' for defending the faith of Nicaea.

works.t: On the Councils, or the Faith of the Easterns

name: St Jerome
label: western
bio: Priest, monk and Bible scholar who translated the Scriptures into Latin and lived his last years in Bethlehem.

works.t: The Perpetual Virginity of Blessed Mary
To Pammachius Against John of Jerusalem
The Life of Malchus, the Captive Monk
The Life of Paulus the First Hermit
Apology for himself against the Books of Rufinus

name: St Leo the Great
label: western
bio: Bishop of Rome. His Tome was read at the Council of Chalcedon on the two natures of Christ.

name: St Vincent of Lérins
label: western
bio: A monk who gave the rule for the true faith: what has been believed everywhere, always and by all.

works.t: Commonitory for the Antiquity and Universality of the Catholic Faith

name: Early Church documents
label: document
bio: The Didache, a 1st-century guide to Christian life, prayer and the Eucharist, and the Apostolic Constitutions, a 4th-century collection of church order.

name: The Epistle of Barnabas
label: document
bio: An early letter reading the Old Testament as pointing to Christ. Not by the Apostle Barnabas, though it carries his name.

name: The Letter to Diognetus
label: document
bio: An early letter by an unknown Christian ('a disciple') explaining how Christians live in the world but are not of it.

name: The Shepherd of Hermas
label: document
bio: A book of visions and teachings on repentance, much read in the early Church.

name: The ancient Liturgies
label: document
bio: Early forms of the Divine Liturgy, including the Liturgy of St James, still served on his feast.

works.t: The Liturgy of the Blessed Apostles

name: Aphrahat the Persian Sage
label: writer
bio: A Syriac teacher whose Demonstrations explain the faith simply, from the Scriptures.

name: Archelaus
label: writer
bio: Account of a debate with Mani, founder of the Manichees.

works.t: Acts of the Disputation with the Heresiarch Manes

name: Aristides of Athens
label: writer
bio: An Athenian Christian whose Apology, addressed to the emperor, is one of the oldest defences of the faith.

name: Arnobius
label: writer
bio: A convert who wrote Against the Heathen soon after becoming a Christian.

name: Athenagoras of Athens
label: writer
bio: A Christian philosopher who wrote a defence of the Christians and a treatise on the resurrection.

name: Clement of Alexandria
label: writer
bio: A teacher in Alexandria who showed how faith and true learning fit together. Honoured as an early writer, but not counted among the saints in the Orthodox calendar.

works.t: Who is the Rich Man That Shall Be Saved?

name: Commodian
label: writer
bio: A Latin Christian poet.

name: Eusebius of Caesarea
label: writer
bio: The first Church historian. Without his Church History we would know far less about the early Church, though he leaned toward Arius.

works.t: Oration of Constantine "to the Assembly of the Saints"
Letter on the Council of Nicaea

name: Gaius of Rome
label: writer
bio: A Roman presbyter who mentions the tombs of Sts Peter and Paul in Rome.

name: Gennadius of Marseilles
label: writer
bio: A priest who listed the Christian writers of his day.

name: Jacob of Serugh
label: writer
bio: A Syriac poet-preacher, honoured by the Syriac churches.

name: Julius Africanus
label: writer
bio: A Christian historian who worked out a chronology of the world.

name: Lactantius
label: writer
bio: A teacher of rhetoric who wrote the Divine Institutes, a defence of the faith for educated pagans.

works.t: The Epitome of the Divine Institutes
Of the Manner In Which the Persecutors Died
A Poem on the Passion of the Lord

name: Malchion
label: writer
bio: A priest of Antioch who exposed the heresy of Paul of Samosata.

name: Minucius Felix
label: writer
bio: A Roman lawyer whose dialogue Octavius defends the faith.

name: Novatian
label: writer
bio: A Roman priest who wrote well on the Trinity but led a schism against the Church's mercy to the repentant.

name: Origen
label: writer
bio: A brilliant Bible scholar of Alexandria. Some of his speculations, such as the pre-existence of souls, were later condemned (553), so read him with care.

works.t: Commentary on the Gospel of John
Commentary on the Gospel of Matthew

name: Rufinus of Aquileia
label: writer
bio: A monk and translator who explained the Apostles' Creed.

name: Socrates Scholasticus
label: writer
bio: A lawyer of Constantinople who carried on Eusebius' history to 439.

name: Sozomen
label: writer
bio: Another historian of the 4th and early 5th century Church.

name: Sulpicius Severus
label: writer
bio: A Christian writer from Gaul best known for his life of St Martin of Tours.

works.t: On the Life of St. Martin

name: Tertullian
label: writer
bio: A sharp Latin writer from Carthage who coined much Christian vocabulary, but later joined the Montanist sect.

works.t: On the Resurrection of the Flesh
The Martyrdom of Perpetua and Felicity

name: Theodoret of Cyrus
label: writer
bio: Bishop and historian. His writings against St Cyril were condemned in 553, but his history is valuable.

works.t: Counter-Statements to Cyril's 12 Anathemas against Nestorius

name: Venantius Fortunatus
label: writer
bio: A Latin poet and bishop, author of hymns on the Cross.
